name: std::relation

declarations.code:
template <class R, class T, class U>

concept relation =

    std::predicate<R, T, T> && std::predicate<R, U, U> &&

    std::predicate<R, T, U> && std::predicate<R, U, T>;

intro: The concept relation<R, T, U> specifies that R defines a binary relation over the set of expressions whose type and value category are those encoded by either T or U.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Check relation for std::less<>, int, int.
